selectionRationale: Inventories the complete five-case initial-mode family before teaching the XSLT30 harness to preserve initial-mode names and local parameters.

cases.rationale: The harness does not yet map the initial-mode name into Weaver's transform options.
The harness does not yet preserve the requested initial mode needed to verify XTDE0045 for a #all-only rule.
The harness does not yet preserve the requested initial mode before checking the required global parameter diagnostic.
The harness currently cannot distinguish initial-mode local and tunnel parameters from global stylesheet parameters.
The harness does not yet map the requested name used to select one mode from a multi-mode template rule.
